descriptionPlain: Fam (previously FamPay), an Indian payments app, is hiring a Data Engineer II to build a scalable data lakehouse with sub-minute latency and unified batch and streaming compute.

lists.content:
• 3-5 years in data engineering with distributed and cloud-native systems
  • Expert Python, PySpark and SQL
  • Hands-on AWS (S3, EKS, MSK) and Infrastructure-as-Code
  • Airflow or Temporal experience
  • Proficiency with AI coding tools
  • Writing technical design documents
  • Domain modeling: facts, dimensions, SCDs

• Real-time CDC with Debezium or PeerDB and Kafka
  • Iceberg, Delta or Hudi table formats
  • Flink ETL/ELT
  • Tuning Trino or ClickHouse
